description: Save an approved Markdown report, analysis, research result, or dashboard summary as durable BAMF creator knowledge with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or BAMF session provenance. Show the exact destination, title, content summary, and provenance to the user before calling this write tool.

content.description: Durable Markdown or JSON-compatible text, maximum 200KB.

source_session_url.description: Optional visible Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or BAMF session URL. Omit when the host does not expose it.

name: bamf.save_agent_artifact
